```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)

TABLE_NUMBER <- 0
```

```{r}
#| label: sample_size
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

cat(paste0("\\textcolor{red}{\\texttt{\\textbf{Table ", TABLE_NUMBER, ".a) SAMPLE SIZE}}}\\vspace{5mm}"))

cat("\\begin{adjustwidth}{1cm}{0cm}")
cat("\\begin{verbatim}")
  df_samples <- readRDS("export/rds/df_samples.rds")
  cat(paste("Given alpha = 0.05\n\n"))
  sep = c(rep(" ", length(df_samples)))
  df_formatted <- df_samples |> mutate (
    Power = sprintf("%.2f", Power)
  )
  colnames(df_formatted) <- c("Power", "Delta = 0.3", "Delta = 0.4", "Delta = 0.5")
  df_with_header <- rbind(as.list(colnames(df_formatted)), sep, df_formatted)
  df_char <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_with_header, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df_aligned <- as.data.frame(mapply(format, df_char, justify = c(rep("centre", ncol(df_char))), SIMPLIFY = FALSE), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  write.table(
    df_aligned,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE,
    quote = FALSE,
    sep = "     "
  )
cat("\\end{verbatim}")
cat("\\end{adjustwidth}")
cat("\\vspace{5mm}")
```

```{r}
#| label: power_analysis
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

cat(paste0("\\textcolor{red}{\\texttt{\\textbf{Table ", TABLE_NUMBER, ".b) POWER ANALYSIS}}}\\vspace{5mm}"))

cat("\\begin{adjustwidth}{1cm}{0cm}\n")
cat("\\begin{verbatim}\n")
  df <- readRDS("export/rds/df_complete.rds")
  cat(paste("Given N =", nrow(df), "+ alpha = 0.05\n\n"))
  df_powers <- readRDS("export/rds/df_powers.rds")
  sep = c(rep(" ", length(df_powers)))
  df_formatted <- df_powers|>
    mutate(
      across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.2f", .))
    )
  colnames(df_formatted) <- c("Delta = 0.3", "Delta = 0.4", "Delta = 0.5")
  df_with_header <- rbind(as.list(colnames(df_formatted)), sep, df_formatted)
  df_char <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_with_header, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df_aligned <- as.data.frame(mapply(format, df_char, justify = c(rep("centre", ncol(df_char))), SIMPLIFY = FALSE), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  write.table(
    df_aligned,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE,
    quote = FALSE,
    sep = "     "
  )
  TABLE_NUMBER <- TABLE_NUMBER + 1
cat("\\end{verbatim}")
cat("\\end{adjustwidth}")
cat("\\vspace{5mm}")
```

```{r}
#| label: descriptive
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

cat(paste0("\\textcolor{red}{\\texttt{\\textbf{Table ", TABLE_NUMBER, ") DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS}}}\\vspace{5mm}"))

cat("\\begin{adjustwidth}{1cm}{0cm}")
cat("\\begin{verbatim}\n")
  df_descr_1 <- readRDS("export/rds/df_descr.rds") |>
    select(var_name, n_valid, n_missing, mean, sd_val, ci_lower, ci_upper)
  sep = c(rep(" ", length(df_descr_1)))
  df_formatted <- df_descr_1 |>
     mutate(
       across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .)),
       n_valid = as.integer(n_valid),
       n_missing = as.integer(n_missing)
      )
  colnames(df_formatted) <- c("Variable", "N", "Missing", "Mean", "SD", "95%CI Low", "95%CI High")
  df_with_header <- rbind(as.list(colnames(df_formatted)), sep, df_formatted)
  df_char <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_with_header, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df_aligned <- as.data.frame(mapply(format, df_char, justify = c(rep("centre", ncol(df_char))), SIMPLIFY = FALSE), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  write.table(
    df_aligned,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE,
    quote = FALSE,
    sep = "     "
  )
  cat("\n")
  df_descr_2 <- readRDS("export/rds/df_descr.rds") |>
    select(var_name, min_val, q1, q2, q3, max_val, sw_p)
  df_formatted <- df_descr_2 |>
    mutate(
      across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .))
    )
  colnames(df_formatted) <- c("Variable", "Min", "Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Max", "Shapiro (p)")
  sep = c(rep(" ", length(df_formatted)))
  df_with_header <- rbind(as.list(colnames(df_formatted)), sep, df_formatted)
  df_char <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_with_header, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df_aligned <- as.data.frame(mapply(format, df_char, justify = c(rep("centre", ncol(df_char))), SIMPLIFY = FALSE), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  write.table(
    df_aligned,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE,
    quote = FALSE,
    sep = "     "
  )
  TABLE_NUMBER <- TABLE_NUMBER + 1

cat("\\end{verbatim}")
cat("\\vspace{5mm}")

  plot_list_descr <- list.files(path = "export/img", pattern = "^plot_descr_.*\\.pdf$", full.names = TRUE)
  plot_list_qq <- list.files(path = "export/img", pattern = "^plot_qq_.*\\.pdf$", full.names = TRUE)
  plot_number <- length(plot_list_descr)

for (n in 1:plot_number) {
  cat("\\vspace{5mm}")
  cat("\\begin{center}\n")
  cat(paste0("\\includegraphics[width=0.45\\textwidth]{", plot_list_descr[n],"}\n"))
  cat("\\hfill\n")
  cat(paste0("\\includegraphics[width=0.45\\textwidth]{", plot_list_qq[n],"}\n"))
  cat("\\end{center}\n")
}

cat("\\end{adjustwidth}")
```

```{r}
#| label: comparison
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| out.width: "80%"

cat(paste0("\\textcolor{red}{\\texttt{\\textbf{Table ", TABLE_NUMBER, ") MULTIPLE COMPARISONS (\\underline{- using complete cases only -})}}}\\vspace{5mm}"))

rds_files <- list.files(
  path = "export/rds", 
  pattern = "^df_shapiro_.*\\.rds$",
  full.names = FALSE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)
var_names <- sub("^df_shapiro_", "", rds_files)
var_names <- sub("\\.rds$", "", var_names)
var_names <- var_names[!is.na(var_names) & var_names != ""]

for (name in var_names) {
  
  cat("\\begin{adjustwidth}{1cm}{0cm}")
  cat("\\begin{minipage}{\\linewidth}")
  header <- paste0("Table ", TABLE_NUMBER, "." , which(var_names == name), ") [", toupper(name), "] ANALYSIS")
  cat(paste0("\\textcolor{red}{\\texttt{\\textbf{Table ", TABLE_NUMBER, "." , which(var_names == name), ") [", toupper(name), "] ANALYSIS}}}"))
  cat("\\begin{verbatim}")
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NORMALITY CHECK
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  cat("\\end{verbatim}")
  cat("\\textcolor{red}{\\texttt{· NORMALITY CHECK\\newline}}")
  cat("\\begin{verbatim}")
  df_shapiro <- readRDS(paste0("export/rds/df_shapiro_", name, ".rds")) |> select(-2)
  sep = c(rep(" ", length(df_shapiro)))
  df_formatted <- df_shapiro |>
    mutate(
      across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .))
    )
  df_formatted <- data.frame(lapply(df_formatted, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(df_formatted) <- c("Time", "Statistic", "P-value", "Normality")
  df_with_header <- rbind(as.list(colnames(df_formatted)), sep, df_formatted)
  df_char <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_with_header, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df_aligned <- as.data.frame(mapply(format, df_char, justify = c(rep("centre", ncol(df_char))), SIMPLIFY = FALSE), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  write.table(
    df_aligned,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE,
    quote = FALSE,
    sep = "     "
  )
  cat("\n")
  if(all(df_shapiro$p > 0.05)) {
    cat("\\end{verbatim}")
    cat("\\colorbox{yellow}{\\texttt{Normality RESPECTED --> ANOVA}}")
    cat("\\begin{verbatim}")
    
    # ANOVA
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    cat("\\end{verbatim}")
    cat("\\textcolor{red}{\\texttt{· ANOVA ± CORRECTED ANOVA\\newline}}")
    cat("\\begin{verbatim}")
    df_anova <- readRDS(paste0("export/rds/df_anova_", name, ".rds"))
    sep = c(rep(" ", length(df_anova)))
    df_formatted <- df_anova |>
      mutate(
        across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .))
      )
    df_formatted <- data.frame(lapply(df_formatted, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    colnames(df_formatted) <- c("Statistic", "DoF", "P-value", "P-Mauchly", "GG-epsilon")
    df_with_header <- rbind(as.list(colnames(df_formatted)), sep, df_formatted)
    df_char <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_with_header, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df_aligned <- as.data.frame(mapply(format, df_char, justify = c(rep("centre", ncol(df_char))), SIMPLIFY = FALSE), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    write.table(
      df_aligned,
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = FALSE,
      quote = FALSE,
      sep = "     "
    )
    cat("\n")
    if(df_anova$p_mauchly >= 0.05) {
      cat("\\end{verbatim}")
      cat(paste0("\\colorbox{yellow}{\\texttt{p-Mauchly >= 0.05 -> No correction needed}}\\newline"))
      cat("\\begin{verbatim}")
    } else {
      cat("\\end{verbatim}")
      cat(paste0("\\colorbox{yellow}{\\texttt{p-Mauchly < 0.05 -> Correction needed}}\\newline\\newline"))
      if (df_anova$GGe < 0.75) {
        cat(paste0("\\colorbox{yellow}{\\texttt{GG-epsilon <= 0.75 -> Greenhouse-Geisser correction}}\\newline"))
      } else {
        cat(paste0("\\colorbox{yellow}{\\texttt{GG-epsilon > 0.75 -> Huynh-Feldt correction}}\\newline"))
      }
      cat("\\begin{verbatim}")
    }
    cat("\n")
    df_anova_corrected <- readRDS(paste0("export/rds/df_anova_corrected_", name, ".rds"))
    sep = c(rep(" ", length(df_anova_corrected)))
    df_formatted <- df_anova_corrected |>
      mutate(
        across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .))
      )
    df_formatted <- data.frame(lapply(df_formatted, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    colnames(df_formatted) <- c("Statistic", "DoF", "P-value", "Correction")
    df_with_header <- rbind(as.list(colnames(df_formatted)), sep, df_formatted)
    df_char <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_with_header, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df_aligned <- as.data.frame(mapply(format, df_char, justify = c(rep("centre", ncol(df_char))), SIMPLIFY = FALSE), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    write.table(
      df_aligned,
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = FALSE,
      quote = FALSE,
      sep = "     "
    )
    cat("\n")
    
    # HOLM/BONFERRONI PAIRWISE COMPARISON
    cat("\\end{verbatim}\n")
    cat("\\textcolor{red}{\\texttt{· HOLM/BONFERRONI PAIRWISE COMPARISON\\newline}}")
    cat("\\begin{verbatim}\n")
    df_pairwise <- readRDS(paste0("export/rds/df_p_values_", name, ".rds")) |>
      select(group1, group2, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, statistic, effsize, p.adj)
    sep = c(rep(" ", length(df_pairwise)))
    df_formatted <- df_pairwise |>
      mutate(
        estimate = sprintf("%.2f", estimate),
        conf.low = sprintf("%.2f", conf.low),
        conf.high = sprintf("%.2f", conf.high),
        statistic = sprintf("%.2f", statistic),
        effsize = sprintf("%.2f", effsize),
        p.adj = case_when(
          p.adj < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
          TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p.adj)
        )
      )
    df_formatted <- data.frame(lapply(df_formatted, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    colnames(df_formatted) <- c("Group 1", "Group 2", "Mean Diff", "95% CI Low", "95% CI High", "t", "Cohen's d", "P-value")
    df_with_header <- rbind(as.list(colnames(df_formatted)), sep, df_formatted)
    df_char <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_with_header, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df_aligned <- as.data.frame(mapply(format, df_char, justify = c(rep("centre", ncol(df_char))), SIMPLIFY = FALSE), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    write.table(
      df_aligned,
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = FALSE,
      quote = FALSE,
      sep = "   "
    )
    cat("\n")

  } else {
    cat("\\end{verbatim}")
    cat("\\colorbox{yellow}{\\texttt{Normality VIOLATED --> FRIEDMAN'S TEST}}\\newline")
    cat("\\begin{verbatim}")
    
    # FRIEDMAN TEST
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    cat("\\end{verbatim}")
    cat("\\textcolor{red}{\\texttt{· FRIEDMAN'S TEST\\newline}}")
    cat("\\begin{verbatim}")
    df_friedman <- readRDS(paste0("export/rds/df_friedman_", name, ".rds"))
    sep = c(rep(" ", length(df_friedman)))
    df_formatted <- df_friedman |>
      mutate(
        across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .))
      )
    df_formatted <- data.frame(lapply(df_formatted, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    colnames(df_formatted) <- c("Chi squared", "DoF", "P-value")
    df_with_header <- rbind(as.list(colnames(df_formatted)), sep, df_formatted)
    df_char <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_with_header, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df_aligned <- as.data.frame(mapply(format, df_char, justify = c(rep("centre", ncol(df_char))), SIMPLIFY = FALSE), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    write.table(
      df_aligned,
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = FALSE,
      quote = FALSE,
      sep = "     "
    )
    cat("\n")
    
    # DURBIN/CONOVER PAIRWISE COMPARISON
    cat("\\end{verbatim}")
    cat("\\textcolor{red}{\\texttt{· DURBIN/CONOVER PAIRWISE COMPARISON\\newline}}")
    cat("\\begin{verbatim}")
    df_conover <- readRDS(paste0("export/rds/df_conover_", name, ".rds")) |>
      select(Group1, Group2, med_diff, ci_lower, ci_upper, Statistic, p_value)
    sep = c(rep(" ", length(df_conover)))
    df_formatted <- df_conover |>
      mutate(
        med_diff  = sprintf("%.2f", med_diff),
        ci_lower  = sprintf("%.2f", ci_lower),
        ci_upper  = sprintf("%.2f", ci_upper),
        Statistic = sprintf("%.2f", Statistic),
        p_value   = case_when(
          p_value < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
          TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p_value)
        )
      )
    df_formatted <- data.frame(lapply(df_formatted, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    colnames(df_formatted) <- c("Group 1", "Group 2", "Median Diff", "95% CI Low", "95% CI High", "Statistic", "P-value")
    df_with_header <- rbind(as.list(colnames(df_formatted)), sep, df_formatted)
    df_char <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_with_header, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df_aligned <- as.data.frame(mapply(format, df_char, justify = c(rep("centre", ncol(df_char))), SIMPLIFY = FALSE), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    write.table(
      df_aligned,
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = FALSE,
      quote = FALSE,
      sep = "   "
    )
  }
  cat("\\end{verbatim}\n")
  
  current_file_path <- file.path("export", "img", paste0("plot_trend_", name, ".pdf"))
  if (file.exists(current_file_path)) {
    cat("\\vspace{7.5mm}")
    cat("\\begin{center}")
    current_plot <- normalizePath(current_file_path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
    current_plot <- gsub("_", "\\_", current_plot, fixed = TRUE)
    cat(paste0("\\includegraphics[width=0.75\\textwidth]{{", current_plot, "}}"))
    cat("\\end{center}")
  }
  
  cat("\\end{minipage}\n")
  cat("\\end{adjustwidth}\n")
}
```
